scope: Offline N7 display experiment on unchanged source geometry, not generated fractional age or production acceptance

anchors.known_research_label: Use original-photo PNG/GLB at the exact filename research label; replace the same-age SAM anchor, never its provenance.
anchors.unknown_source: Keep unknown source age and record missing original-age anchor; SAM target-condition display interpolation does not assign a source age.
anchors.extrapolation: Reject outside the actual anchor coverage; do not clamp or round.

sampling.original_interval_midpoints: Each of the 27 input intervals at midpoint minus/plus epsilon_years, after source anchor replacement.
sampling.source_neighborhoods: Each of 8 known research source labels at exact label and minus/plus epsilon_years within coverage.
sampling.deduplication: One asset per exact source and target float value; retain all comparison requests.

color_alpha.mix: Decode sRGB to linear light, premultiply RGB by alpha, interpolate RGB and alpha together.
color_alpha.encoding: Quantize to straight sRGB RGBA PNG; record quantization and downstream browser canvas/export errors separately.
color_alpha.unknown: Both-unknown pixels remain RGBA zero; partial support means a display fade, not newly observed facial texture.
color_alpha.material: Non-source experimental assets use glTF BLEND; exact original source asset retains original material and bytes.

browser_evidence.transport: Use actual FaceViewer and GLTFLoader, export and reimport; compare geometry arrays and alpha/material semantics.
browser_evidence.rendering: Measure fixed-view neighbor pixel changes and a MASK baseline separately; no invented visual-quality threshold.
browser_evidence.source_reset: Exact original source assets and binary-alpha decoded pixels must be preserved.
browser_evidence.resource_ownership: Loopback-only owned servers and browser processes close after success, failure or cancellation.
